drivingQuestion: How does Rava's validation of a peeled etrog square with the mishna?

segments.en: «this» mishna, where it states that if the etrog was peeled it is unfit, is «in» a case where «all of it» was peeled. «That» statement of Rava that if it was peeled it is fit is «in» a case where only «part of it» was peeled.

moves.summary: resolves the contradiction raised in the previous unit
moves.about: the mishna invalidates an entirely peeled etrog; Rava validates one peeled only in part

edges.about: the mishna invalidates an entirely peeled etrog; Rava validates one peeled only in part

positions.claim: the mishna addresses an entirely peeled etrog, Rava a partly peeled one
